title: Dutch party votes 1963-1971 : Roll calls Tweede Kamer
authors: Verhoef, J., Rijksuniversiteit Leiden * Leiden, Instituut voor politieke wetenschappen (primary investigator)
contributors: Verhoef, J., instituut voor politieke wetenschappen, RUL * Leiden (data collector)
descriptions: Calls 2nd chamber of parliament 1963-1971 / data on type of bill / who signed the bill / number of amendments and votes / parties participating in debate / time-limits to speakers / ministerial advise / ministers and secretaries of state / who spoke in favour of the bill / results of vote per party / party-leader and individual members.
